setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Both channels play four steps. Channel 1 plays 66, 64, 69, 67 and channel 2 plays its A (69) and 76. The song has one slot, Song 01, at the full global length of 64 steps.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8). Tap (2,7), which jumps to 1 step, then tap (8,7) three times. The Playback screen reads Global length 4: the song is one four-step phrase.
steps.title: Set the song length to 4

steps.caption: Hold slot (1,1) and tap (2,1) to copy slot 1 into slot 2, then tap (2,1) to select slot 2. The Slot setup screen names Song 02 and the footer reads Song sequence 2 selected.
steps.title: Copy slot 1 to slot 2

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), select channel 1 at (1,1) and tap octave +1 at (11,8). The octave button lights and the footer reads Ch. 1 octave: 1: channel 1 will play one octave higher in this slot.
steps.title: Raise slot 2 an octave

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play, then Stop. The four-step phrase plays, then repeats an octave higher in slot 2. The MIDI strip shows 66, 64, 69, 67, then 78, 76, 81, 79 on channel 1, while channel 2 plays its A and 76 in both slots.
steps.title: Hear the chain

title: Chain song slots an octave apart
